title: Restore Sketchpad View Gizmo And Camera Snap Views
description: Restore the sketchpad viewport gizmo visibility and enhance it so axis clicks smoothly snap the camera to matching orthographic views, switch projection from perspective to orthographic on snap, and automatically return to perspective after user orbit interaction. Preserve existing viewport controls and behaviors, extend existing tests instead of adding new files, and verify the behavior.
summary: Restored the sketchpad scene gizmo path by making the shared scene camera projection-aware, adding gizmo axis snap target resolution plus smooth camera snapping into orthographic views, and switching back to perspective when the user orbits. Updated the design scene wrapper to keep the gizmo visible and to project drag-drop placement correctly in both perspective and orthographic modes. Extended existing inline scene helper tests and type-app browser assertions for projection switching. Verified with elements/ui vitest and TypeScript checks for elements/ui and compose/sketchpad. A sketchpad Playwright run against the source-backed dev server still fails during the existing Type bootstrap flow with an unrelated navigation-context teardown before the new gizmo assertions execute.
